blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — Baguio artist Adelaida Guia has earned a Guinness World Records title for creating the largest crocheted mandala by a single person, measuring 6 meters (19 feet) in diameter. Guia said she received an email on Thursday, Sept. 17, confirming that her 29-square-meter creation had officially set the world record. “My five children Ezekiel, Jeniel, Danielli, Azriel and Giddiel are super happy for me,” Guia told the Inquirer on Friday.
